observed_content: Exact finite-field generator-closure certificate for Sp6(F3): 3 local Fourier rotations, 3 elementary transvections, 4 directed adjacent coordinate shears. Every 6x6 generator satisfies M^T J M=J mod3. Orbit of nonzero e1 under generators and inverses is all 728 nonzero vectors, diameter six; 364 projective directions. Since T0 is an elementary transvection, conjugation gives transvections in all projective directions; classical theorem says these generate the full symplectic group. Order 9,170,703,360 from known formula.
